reviews.comment: Getting an A feels more like luck than actually having the knowledge, tests are hard to study for. Professor can't teach that well but he is funny. Grading seems inconsistent. You'll probably pass but you wont get the grade you want

Chabum Lee was awful. This class in general is a ton of work but he makes it worse. Very clear that he doesn't care, homework had material we didn't learn so you have to lookup all of it. Assigned work was due over thanksgiving break. Midterm and final(that he wrote) were open note/internet and still had failing averages. Avoid if you can.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dreadful professor for a terrible class. Labs are pretty awful but TA was nice so you get 100% and they're worth 40% of your grade. HW and exam problems seem like he just writes them in Korean and google translates to English, leading to horrible wording. Test averages around 60 for both tests, at least gave 10 makeup problems for 10 pts (test 1).

reviews.comment: Dr.Lee is a terrible professor. His lectures are terribly planned and paced. His exams and homework are way harder than the lecture material. He mentions that he receives bad feedback on his class and that most people fail it, but then laughs and says everyone is wrong. He is a terrible professor, and unwilling to improve or provide help.

reviews.comment: Do not take this professor. I cannot stress that enough. Not even the TAs like the professor. The tests are significantly more difficult than anything else in the class. The labs are fun though.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: A very terrible professor for an already topic-heavy course. The lectures were basically a waste of time. He would spend 40 minutes talking about random things going over 4 slides then spend the last 10 minutes of class rushing through the rest of the slides. He writes his own exams and they're terribly written with a wide grade distribution.

I don't recommend Professor Lee for this class. While yes, all the 260 professors are mid, he I think is the worst. His lectures don't make any sense and didn't help me understand the homework. The one saving grace is the lab grades make up a large portion of your grade and he does extra credit on exams, so you should still be able to pass.

His lectures don't correlate with the homework and exam, so I stopped going to them. Just be sure to attend the review session he has before the exam and go over the homework solutions to help prepare for the midterm and final. He gave us an extra credit opportunity for both exams, which was nice.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Easily the worst professor I've had in my time here. The lectures aren't coherent at all. Exams and homework are extremely difficult and completely different from the lecture material. Most people I've talked to received around a 50 on their first exams. Be ready for a LOT of busywork, and avoid him at all costs.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: The homework, lectures, and exams all feel like they are from different classes. The lectures don't follow the slides he gives and end up being 50 minute tangents that are only vaguely connected to the topics we are supposed to be learning.

The professor does not good communication skills. The lecture materials are totally scattered and all over the place. There is no proper cohesion to the context he teaches. Grading is very random. The exam questions are also quite vague with much less time to complete. Does not curve or give any extra credit assignments. The course is just a show.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Comparing to other Junior level MEEN class, this class is a breeze this semester.

Awful. Half the time, I could not understand what he is saying. Being a foreign English speaker myself, I understand the obstacles he faces, but he makes no effort to speak clearly. I also suffered major software issues pertaining to his class, and he completely dismissed my request for assistance.

Lee does not answer questions well and I didn't find his lectures helpful either. Pretty much all his responses to questions about the class/grades/timeline were that he'd ask in the instructor meeting. Definitely felt like I had to teach myself the material.

Avoid this guy at all costs. He thinks his class takes precedence over all other mechanical engineering classes - he assigns lab reports and homeworks right before other important exams. He does not care for students, and just wants to show his own intelligence to a bunch of college kids. 0/10
